Raw MCP tools are never passed to the agent. run_digest(settings, *, gmail_opener=open_gmail_tools, model_factory=make_model, agent_builder=build_agent) -> ReadingList: log settings.safe_summary(), window and effective query; store = ArticleStore(); async with gmail_opener(settings) as gmail; pre-flight emails = await search_email_refs(gmail['search_emails'], settings.effective_query, settings.max_emails); store.set_search_results; log emails found; if 0 -> return assemble_reading_list with empty store (no agent built, no model constructed); else agent = agent_builder(settings, gmail, store, model_factory=model_factory); await agent.ainvoke({'messages': [{'role':'user','content': build_user_message(settings, n)}]}, config={'recursion_limit': settings.recursion_limit}); catch Exception (incl.
